routes.name: COMPUTE MARKET
routes.description: Golem or another approved requestor/provider market.
routes.path: CONSENT → HELIOS → MARKETPLACE → REQUESTOR → VERIFIED PAYMENT → PLAYER VALUE + TREASURY

routes.name: SCIENCE
routes.description: Research or public-good workload with upstream acceptance.
routes.path: CONSENT → HELIOS → RESEARCH REQUESTOR → SCIENCE WORK → VERIFIED RECEIPT → IMPACT LEDGER

routes.name: JACKPOT POOL
routes.description: Shared mining/pool revenue routed into a transparent reserve.
routes.path: CONSENT → HELIOS → APPROVED POOL → ACCEPTED SHARE → VERIFIED REVENUE → COMPUTE TREASURY

routes.name: DATA CENTER
routes.description: Buyer-selected cloud, batch, render, analytics or HPC workload.
routes.path: CONSENT → HELIOS → DATA CENTER GATEWAY → GENERAL WORKLOAD → VERIFIED RECEIPT → CONTRACT SINK

routes.name: OPERATOR
routes.description: Approved buyer-owned workload behind a private gateway.
routes.path: CONSENT → HELIOS → OPERATOR GATEWAY → APPROVED WORKLOAD → VERIFIED RECEIPT → AUDITED SINK

routes.name: CUSTOM
routes.description: A future admissible provider not known when HELIOS was built.
routes.path: CONSENT → HELIOS → SIGNED BUYER MANIFEST → CUSTOM ADAPTER → VERIFIER → AUDITED SINK
